data.name: Hackathorn
data.long_meaning: A name of Old English origin meaning 'hacker of Thor'. This name symbolizes the strength and intelligence of Thor, the Norse god of thunder, combined with the modern meaning of 'hacker'. It suggests a powerful and intelligent individual who is skilled in problem-solving and protection.
